facts.statement: Plesiohadros is an extinct genus of hadrosauroid dinosaur named for its resemblance to hadrosaurids.
facts.quote: Plesiohadros (meaning "near to hadrosaurids") is an extinct genus of hadrosauroid dinosaur.

facts.statement: The genus is known from a partial skeleton including a skull found at the Alag Teg locality in southern Mongolia.
facts.quote: It is known from a partial skeleton including the skull collected at Alag Teg locality, from the Campanian Alagteeg Formation of southern Mongolia.

facts.statement: Plesiohadros is the only known hadrosaur species found in the Alagteeg Formation.
facts.quote: Plesiohadros is the only known hadrosaur from the Alagteeg Formation.

facts.statement: Plesiohadros is classified within the family Hadrosauridae.
Plesiohadros lived during the late Cretaceous, approximately 80 to 75 million years ago, in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente entre 80 a 75 durante el Campaniense, en lo que es hoy Asia.

facts.statement: The time range for Plesiohadros extends from the Santonian to the Campanian stages, between 85.7 and 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Santonian to Campanian (85.7 to 72.2 million years ago)
